clips.title: Dizains un izstrāde kopā
clips.prompt: A refined abstract 3D motion design film for a contemporary design studio website. Landscape 16:9 composition, fixed camera, one continuous shot. Near-black charcoal background, warm off-white and vermilion orange (#FF4A2E) sculptural objects only. Tactile satin material, subtle studio lighting, crisp geometry, restrained elegant movement. The sculpture fills the central two thirds of the frame and remains completely in frame. No people, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark-like graphics, no UI, no cuts, no camera travel. Five second calm loop, start and end on the same balanced composition. Two complementary architectural pieces, one smooth off-white curved arch and one finely ribbed orange geometric arch, slowly slide toward each other and interlock precisely into a single complete sculptural ring. Their surfaces and seams align perfectly, showing creative form and engineered structure working together. They gently separate and return, a smooth rhythmic mechanical loop.

Macro view of an elegant geometric composition: six off-white rectangular tiles suspended just above a charcoal plane, and a single small vermilion orange cube. clips.title: Saruna visa projekta laikā
clips.prompt: A refined abstract 3D motion design film for a contemporary design studio website. Landscape 16:9 composition, fixed camera, one continuous shot. Near-black charcoal background, warm off-white and vermilion orange (#FF4A2E) sculptural objects only. Tactile satin material, subtle studio lighting, crisp geometry, restrained elegant movement. The sculpture fills the central two thirds of the frame and remains completely in frame. No people, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark-like graphics, no UI, no cuts, no camera travel. Five second calm loop, start and end on the same balanced composition. Two sculptural curved ribbon loops face one another across a small gap, one off-white and one vermilion orange, isolated on charcoal. A small orange sphere glides gently from one ribbon to the other, is received, then returns on a graceful curved path. The ribbons lean gently toward each other in response, like an attentive conversation. Simple readable composition, balanced exchange and continuous collaboration.
